Name: Denver - Seasonal talkohlooeys' Portraits Edit
Author: IBSammy
Description:
talkohlooeys' & MattytheMouse have given permission for people to make edits to their work, and so I did. This is my fifth one, adding seasonal outfits to the edited look of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10219?tab=files#]Matty's Talkohlooeys' Homebrew Edits[/url]'s Denver.

[u][b]Install Instructions:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Install the Denver and Cecilia subsection of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5269]talkohlooeys' Portraits[/url].
[*]﻿Unzip my folder from wherever you saved it
[*]Copy contents from this unzipped folder to \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\﻿
[/list]
[u][b]Small Notes:[/b]
[/u][list]
[*]The most important note is that [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4594]Denver [/url]﻿is presently hidden on Nexus, but I'm uploading this for people who have him, or for if he ever gets unhidden.
[*]I may edit his female looks later, but for now as I am using him as a male, I just edited his two male appearances.
[*]I did not edit in his Spirits Eve outfits, I may cobble something together later, but for now here we are.
[/list]
